pick.headline: Egyptian commando raid at Larnaca ends in bloodshed
pick.summary: On 19 February 1978 Egyptian commandos landed at Larnaca airport to free hostages held on a plane by the killers of Yusuf al-Sibai; Cypriot forces opened fire and fifteen commandos died.
pick.significance: The botched raid led Egypt to break relations with Cyprus.
